items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Terminology 38:1
items.html: When the male is entirely Hassadim and the Nukva is entirely Gevurot alone, they are considered separated from one another. For she is in oppositeness of form to the male, since the form of the Gevurot is opposite to the form of the Hassadim. And it is known that the matter of adhesion and separation spoken of in spiritual things is the matter of equivalence of form and disparity of form. (p. 652, Item 57)
